errors.text_span: remaining relatively stable until a Prompt Depth of 7
errors.evidence: The description uses the subjective term "relatively stable" instead of describing the trend using the requested data points. The plot shows minor fluctuations between J=1 and J=7 (from 80.0% to 80.3% and back to 80.2%).

errors.text_span: rising to approximately 77.5% at a Prompt Depth of 7 and 9
errors.evidence: The accuracy value for the mmsd2 model at a Prompt Depth of 9 is visibly higher than at a Prompt Depth of 7. The value at J=7 is approximately 77.5%, but at J=9 it is higher, around 77.6%, which is the peak for this line. Stating the values are the same is incorrect.
